subject: math

objective.text: Draw arrays with X's. Use lines to show rows and columns. Write repeated addition.

explanations.title: Columns and vertical lines
explanations.text: A column goes up and down. Draw a line between each column. The lines help you see each column as one group, or unit.

explanations.title: Rows and horizontal lines
explanations.text: A row goes straight across. Draw a line between each row. Each row is also a group, or unit.

explanations.title: Rows or columns, same total
explanations.text: 3 columns of 5 and 3 rows of 5 both make 15. It is just a different way of grouping to make 15.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (S: they equal the same amount)

explanations.title: How to draw an array
explanations.text: To draw 4 columns of 2, draw one column of 2 X's first. Then draw 3 more columns of 2. Put a line between the groups.

explanations.title: Add or remove a group
explanations.text: Add one more column of 4 and the total goes up by 4. Take away 2 columns of 4 and the total goes down by 8.

examples.title: 3 columns of 5
examples.text: 3 columns with 5 in each column. 5 plus 5 plus 5 equals 15.

examples.title: 3 rows of 5
examples.text: The same 15 beans in 3 rows of 5. 5 plus 5 plus 5 equals 15.

examples.title: 4 columns of 2
examples.text: Draw a column of 2 X's, then 3 more columns of 2. 2 plus 2 plus 2 plus 2 equals 8. 4 rows of 2 also equals 8.

examples.title: 3 columns of 4
examples.text: 4 plus 4 plus 4 equals 12. Add a column: 4 plus 4 plus 4 plus 4 equals 16. Take away 2 columns: 4 plus 4 equals 8.

assets_required.why_this_method: Exact X counts, group lines between rows or columns, and adding or removing a group need exact behaviour. Diffusion cannot count.
assets_required.description: A drawn array of X marks. Lines can separate the rows or the columns. A row or a column can be added or removed.
must_show_exactly: Exactly the X count in the stimulus
Every row has the same number of X's
Every column has the same number of X's
Vertical lines separate columns; horizontal lines separate rows
Add or remove changes the count by exactly one row or column
assets_required.interaction: Tutor sets rows, columns and line type from the stimulus. Child can add or remove a row or column. Child answers by voice or typing.
assets_required.alt_text: A grid of X marks with lines between the rows or columns.
assets_required.generation_caption: Simple grid of X marks with thin lines between groups, plain white background. [Build by code]
